281528518.description:
Geoscience Industries
Introductory Earth Science Collection
Rock and Mineral Specimen Study Set
The Geoscience Industries Introductory Earth Science Collection is an educational geology study kit designed for classroom and laboratory learning. The set systematically organizes earth science specimens covering Mohs hardness scale minerals, rock-forming minerals, metallic and nonmetallic ores, as well as igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rock types.
Molded grid tray housing individually numbered geological specimens
Includes printed Introductory Earth Science Collection reference chart
Accompanied by Rocks, Minerals, and Gemstones study guide booklet
Includes streak plates, scratch test nail, and magnet accessory
Stored in original partitioned box measuring approximately 19.75 x 11.25 inches
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage set in very good condition. Most numbered specimens are present and securely seated; one compartment is unoccupied. Reference guide and key chart are intact with mild handling wear. Compartment tray and outer box exhibit light surface scuffs and dust consistent with previous educational use.
THANK YOU FOR YOUR PURCHASE!
If you’re happy and you know it, please leave a 5-star rating! If there is a problem with your order, please contact us via Shop Goodwill before opening returns/claims. We strive to return all messages within one business day.
Please click the shipping estimate link in the listing to get the shipping costs directly from FedEx.  There will be no discounts or price changes after an auction has ended.
Our shipping team works hard to get out all orders as quickly as possible, that being said it may take up to 5 business days after payment for your order to ship out.  Once it ships out you will receive tracking information.
***IMPORTANT*** If your item was damaged in transit, do not throw away anything, including the box or packing materials until we have authorized you to do so. Photos will be required to file insurance claims.
Our Business hours: Monday - Friday  8:00 am to 4:00 pm Central
New items and unique treasures are added daily, come back soon!

278828365.description: A collection of polished agate and geode stone halves showcasing natural patterns and textures. These stones are ideal for decorative purposes, collections, or educational use.

281945302.description: This large quartz crystal geode specimen features a rough tan-brown outer rock matrix with a hollow interior lined with clear to white quartz crystals. The crystals are well-formed and densely clustered, creating a sparkling effect inside the cavity. The geode is in natural, unpolished condition with some minor earth staining on the exterior. It weighs approximately 3.9 lbs and measures about 5 to 6 inches in length.

282164319.description: Vintage revolving wooden tobacco pipe stand with a glass jar humidor featuring a wooden lid. The circular rack holds multiple tobacco smoking pipes in various shapes and materials. Included is a carved elephant-head pipe with ivory or bone tusks. Pipes and stand show signs of use and age. See photos for condition. Suitable for collectors of smoking memorabilia or tobacciana.
